event.description: Use mixed-length warmup then full-range curriculum at width 15
event.proposal: Family: training control. Current retained frontier is 2,128 parameters at 99.140000%, a +0.140000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 2 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted in-family result is attempt-0002, the 45k schedule extension; the most recent failed result is attempt-0037, full-range-only width-15 training, which remained at 0% validation and hit the 20k abort. Attempt-0032 had previously reached 98.75% at width 15 using mixed digit lengths throughout. Hypothesis: mixed lengths for the first 20k steps teach local addition and carry mechanics, after which full-range sampling for 25k steps concentrates refinement on the evaluated scale; model size remains 2,096. This is more informative than the nearest untested fixed mixture because the two measured extremes identify distinct learnability and distribution-allocation phases, and the staged switch tests their causal combination within the same budget.
